rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP and looked up multiple orders, which aligns with policy. However, there’s no evidence the agent provided the requested tracking number, and no return was initiated or even confirmed with the user before any write (though no write occurred). The agent transferred to a human due to the refund-to-AMEX request while only PayPal is on file, which is an appropriate handoff. Still, the user’s request also included obtaining the tracking number—a task the agent could handle—and partially setting up the return (at least after confirmation) before handing off. Since the agent did not complete the actionable parts within policy (no tracking info given, no confirmed return step), the overall outcome does not meet the pass bar.
